cand.title: Plans a purpose-built Tier IV data center in Guadalajara with 100,000 square feet, 6 MW power infrastructure and on-site office floors.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two verified executive relationship candidates, neither a verified hotel buyer: Eduardo Basulto Jiménez, CEO of HostDime México, is quoted on the Guadalajara project and is the strongest local introduction route; Manny Vivar, CEO and founder of HostDime Global, is quoted on the investment strategy and is a possible escalation sponsor. Hotel contract control is not established for either.
findings.futureEdition: No event edition or dated inauguration verified for November 2026–May 2028. HostDime’s Mexico facility page explicitly targets bringing the new Tier IV facility to life in 2028, without a month or day. A separate corporate Tier 4 page still says 2026. Use 2028 as the more project-specific planning signal, not a confirmed opening date; this does not establish activity by May 2028. Actual groundbreaking, commissioning and opening dates remain unverified.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied Sheraton profile: city-business accommodation and small project meetings are a more plausible fit than a resort programme. Potential demand could arise from visiting technical teams, vendors, commissioning personnel or customer deployments, but none is confirmed or quantified. The operating facility is in Jardines de Plaza del Sol; the new project is in San Agustín, so Expo adjacency alone does not establish a convenient new-site commute. Confirm journey times and traveler preferences before proposing the 216-room hotel; no Expo-linked event is verified.
findings.venueCommitments: The project page identifies the planned facility at Av. Adolfo López Mateos Sur 125, 45640 San Agustín, Jalisco, Mexico. This is a development site, not a hotel booking or event venue commitment. The operating Tier III facility is separately listed at Avenida López Mateos Sur 2077, Jardines de Plaza del Sol, Guadalajara. No incumbent hotel or signed accommodation commitment was identified in the reviewed sources.
findings.historicalRotation: Not an edition-based or rotating event. Historical project forecasts, not completed editions: the July 2022 land-purchase announcement estimated Q4 2023 completion; the November 2022 design announcement anticipated Q1 2023 construction and 2024 commissioning; July 2025 reporting described a proposed second-half-2025 construction start. None establishes that the forecast activities occurred. The current project-specific Mexico facility page says 2028.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown/unconfirmed. No published hotel RFP, accommodation booking channel, room block, procurement agency or hotel-selection deadline was identified. The official Mexico contact page provides a local office route; ask for the person responsible for project-team travel and supplier accommodation. Its sales contact channel is not evidence of hotel-buying authority.
findings.organizationStructure: Corporate data-center owner/developer/operator, not an association, PCO or DMC. The design announcement explicitly identifies HostDime as owner, developer and operator of Andromeda. HostDime México provides the local operating relationship; the sources do not identify the legal entity that would contract for hotel accommodation.
findings.competitiveLimitations: HostDime’s operating Tier III facility already provides a conference room and client lounge. The 2022 Andromeda design includes office floors and an indoor/outdoor technology-event space, all planned rather than verified as delivered. Inference: these amenities could reduce off-site meeting demand. No competing incumbent hotel, hotel-capacity constraint, sold-out period or accommodation overflow is evidenced.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact the Mexico office through its official contact page, request an introduction to Eduardo Basulto Jiménez’s office, and identify the actual travel/procurement or project-logistics owner. Ask for the current construction/commissioning milestone calendar, whether any visiting teams need paid lodging before 31 May 2028, approximate stay patterns, site-transport requirements, and existing hotel agreements. Only then offer a project/corporate-rate discussion for Sheraton Guadalajara Expo. Keep outside the qualified event pipeline pending dated demand and sourcing confirmation; final qualification remains with ORS.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: No current event edition, registration route or live hotel-sourcing process is verified. The existing Mexico operation is commercially contactable, but that is access to a corporate relationship, not proof of accessible room demand. Do not publish this as an open event lead.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: retain as a conditional corporate-account/project-travel prospect, not recurring event capture. A 2028 project target creates a reason to validate commissioning and supplier travel, but neither recurrence nor room nights within November 2026–May 2028 is established. Any opening reception or technology conference remains speculative until separately announced.

November 2022 design announcement: HostDime owner/developer/operator; Andromeda name; forecast Q1 2023 construction and 2024 commissioning; planned office floors and technology-event space.
supportingSources.factVsInference: historical announcement and forecasts; not proof of completion

supportingSources.claim: July 2022 land-purchase announcement estimated Q4 2023 completion; this is an expired forecast, not a completed event.
Corporate Tier 4 overview still says Mexico opening in 2026, conflicting with the project-specific Mexico page’s 2028 target.
July 2025 report described intended second-half-2025 Mexico construction start, not an observed start.
Local team page identifies Eduardo Basulto as CEO.
Official Mexico contact route and Plaza del Sol office address; no hotel-buying mandate established.
Potential project-team stays and off-site meetings are a conditional sales thesis; published project specifications do not establish hotel demand.

suggestedOrsFollowUps: Resolve the 2026 versus 2028 schedule discrepancy with HostDime México and obtain dated evidence of activity within the required horizon.
Request referral to the actual lodging decision-maker and confirm traveler volumes, incumbent arrangements and whether hotel selection is open.
Validate the San Agustín site commute and separate existing-facility account demand from new-project demand; qualify only dated, sourced business.
remainingUncertainties: Exact construction progress and actual milestone dates as of 14 November 2026 are not verified; the 2028 project-specific target conflicts with a corporate page still stating 2026.
No month or day is published for the 2028 target, so opening or commissioning by 31 May 2028 is unproven.
Travel volume, attendance, room nights, peak rooms, budgets and stay dates are unpublished in the reviewed materials.
The hotel buyer, contracting entity, procurement intermediary, incumbent hotels and any open hotel-sourcing process remain unidentified.
No dated inauguration or recurring technology-event series has been verified; the designed event space is not an event calendar.
New-site commute suitability relative to the Expo-adjacent hotel remains untested.
